title: hickory-proto and hickory-resolver 0.26.0 before 0.26.2, hickory-server 0.25.0-alpha.1 before 0.26.2, and…
description: Multiple Hickory components prior to version 0.26.2 fail to properly canonicalize IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses when enforcing deny_answers, deny_server, or AccessControlSet rules. This flaw allows attackers to bypass answer filtering, cause queries to denied nameservers, or access Hickory server deployments on dual-stack IPv6 sockets from clients that should be denied.
